items.html: And the matter is this: after the aspects of Aba and Ima themselves were sorted by the one who preceded them, whose matter we have no permission to mention, behold, afterward Aba and Ima coupled together to sort the portions of the discernments of ZON. And then, through their coupling, those sparks of the portions of ZON are sorted and rise from below, from the place where the kings fell at the time of their death, and they rise upward and enter within the belly of the supernal Ima, and they remain and linger there all the days of the months of the time of gestation. And there they are sweetened, corrected, and joined, and become the aspect of a Partzuf; and ZON are born and come out, as is known.
